preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 400,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui <= n and 1 <= vi <= n for ui, vi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect vertices with indices between 1 and n.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ' '.join(str(1 if can_be_centroid else 0) for can_be_centroid in results)
postconditions.description: The output must be a space-separated string of 1s and 0s indicating whether each vertex can be made a centroid.
